注：1.本表机构包括中国人民银行、银行业存款类金融机构、银行业非存款类金融机构。
1.Financial institutions in this table include PBC, banking depository financial institutions and banking non-depository financial institutions.
2.银行业存款类金融机构包括银行、信用社和财务公司。银行业非存款类金融机构包括信托投资公司、金融租赁公司、汽车金融公司、贷款公司、消费金融公司、理财公司和金融资产投资公司等银行业非存款类金融机构。
2.Banking depository financial institutions include banks, credit cooperatives and finance companies. Banking non-depository financial institutions include financial trust and investment corporations, financial leasing companies, auto-financing companies, loan companies, consumer finance companies, wealth management companies, as well as financial asset investment companies.
3.自2017年起，对国际金融组织相关本币账户以净头寸反映。
3.As of 2017, RMB accounts with international financial organiztions are calculated on a net basis.
